beats.caption: Cinemory. Memories, made into film
beats.narration: Your memories, made into film. And sealed, so anyone can prove it is real. This is Cinemory. It began as an anniversary gift.

beats.caption: The live app. Two photos in, in the order you want them.
beats.narration: Here it is running, live on Cloud Run. I add two photos from an anniversary dinner. They were generated by a model, so nobody real appears in this demo. The order I drop them in becomes the order of the edit.

beats.caption: Pick an occasion. It sets the score, the pacing and the titles
beats.narration: Then I pick an occasion. Each one brings its own score, its own pacing and its own titles. Anniversary runs warm strings at three and a half seconds a clip. Then I hit generate.

beats.caption: A real model call, not a mock. About five minutes per photo
beats.narration: Now the real work. Each photo goes to Kling on GMI Cloud through Genblaze and comes back as a moving clip. That is a live model call, so it takes about five minutes a photo. The job runs in the background and the page polls it.

beats.caption: The reel plays
beats.narration: And the reel plays. Those are real generated clips, animated from the two photos I uploaded, and stitched into one film with the occasion's pacing.

beats.caption: Press Verify. Your own browser recomputes the SHA-256
beats.narration: Now the part that matters. The provenance panel lists every step, the model, the prompt, and a hash for each asset. I press Verify, and the browser recomputes the SHA-256 itself. It matches the sealed manifest hash, so the seal reads Verified.

beats.caption: Every clip cites its source photo, by hash
beats.narration: Underneath, every artifact sits in Backblaze B2 at its own content hash, and each clip cites the exact source photo it came from. Change one byte and the seal breaks.

beats.caption: One core, three ports. Live adapters, offline fakes.
beats.narration: The design is one clean core with three ports. Genblaze drives Kling and seedance through GMI Cloud. Backblaze B2 holds every artifact behind a queryable index. FastAPI and React run on Cloud Run. And offline fakes run the whole pipeline in tests, with no credentials.

beats.caption: Live now · open source · github.com/upgradedev/cinemory
beats.narration: It is live, open source, and when a model is down it degrades in the open instead of faking a result. Cinemory. Memories, made into film, that you can trust.
